heading: 11. Error codes
text:
## 11. Error codes [LOPQ.11]

Compile-time validators (no runtime code):

- **`DS_VALIDATE_OPAQUE_NO_OP`** — a sealed operation applied to an opaque
  receiver: a representation builtin or value ordering ([LOPQ.3.3]; ordering
  deferred, [LOPQ.10.4]), rule-level construction ([LOPQ.4.1]), or rule-level
  elimination ([LOPQ.4.3]).
- **`DS_VALIDATE_OPAQUE_TYPE_MISMATCH`** — an assignment, comparison, or argument
  binding across two distinct opaque types, or between an opaque type and its
  representation ([LOPQ.2.3]).
